question.text: Section VIII of the PPM — 'Principles of Portfolio Valuation' — applies:

answer.text: To Category I and II AIFs only, specifying the Valuer, frequency, IPEV guidelines usage etc.
Only to Category III AIFs due to their daily NAV obligations.
To all AIFs uniformly, including Angel Funds.
Only to AIFs registered after June 2020.

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the chapter, PPM Section VIII 'Principles of Portfolio Valuation' is explicitly scoped to Category I and II AIFs only. It discloses the Valuer of the Fund/Scheme, frequency of valuation (at least once every 6 months, extendable to once a year with 75% by value investor approval), and whether the IPEV Guidelines are applied. The Trap: Cat III has its own daily-NAV framework — this section is Cat I/II specific. It is not Angel-Fund specific and does not hinge on the 2020 template circular for applicability scope. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C covers all three categories; XIX-D (Cat I/II only) emphasises Section VIII. Cat III daily-NAV mechanics live in XIX-E territory — do not confuse. Manager's Pro-Tip: Disclose the valuer-appointment and rotation plan in Section VIII with a real 5-year horizon — LPs and the PPM auditor read this closely, and a generic line like 'as per regulations' will be flagged.
